system.description: You enter a deep trance, slowing your heart nearly to a stop.

outcomes.triumph: You may ask four questions instead of three.
outcomes.success: You ask your deity three questions. The answers are cryptic but truthful, and come as vivid, symbolic dreams.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; your god does not answer.
outcomes.ruin: Something else answers in your god's voice. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
